title: EMO-LLaMA: Enhancing Facial Emotion Understanding with Instruction Tuning

bias_targets.methodology: Ablation study measuring the overall performance impact of explicitly providing the model with Age-Gender-Race (AGR) facial prior information to account for demographic and cultural variations in emotional expressions.
Ablation study evaluating the model's classification performance with and without an imbalanced dataset sampling strategy to mitigate the long-tail distribution problem of emotion categories.
Cross-dataset and cross-modality (image-to-video and video-to-image) zero-shot evaluations to test the model's generalization capabilities and ability to overcome dataset-specific biases.
